judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a failing acceptance test and did not modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` at all, meaning `npm test` fails on the newly added test. In `.lore/dod.md`, the candidate explicitly marked multiple acceptance criteria from the issue (handling missing usage on some rounds, updating the hook parameter signature, and updating the CHANGELOG) as out of scope. Furthermore, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate appended a contradictory line under 'Measured semantics — out of scope' instead of replacing the old under-counting line and moving the validated behaviour to the main spec section as requested. The test setup itself in `chatUsage.acceptance.test.ts` is reasonable, though the reference added its tests directly to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
